In an impressive display of academic excellence, students from Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Gandipet, Hyderabad have brought laurels to their institute by winning multiple gold medals awarded by Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad (JNTUH).
Highlighting the achievements, the institute proudly announces that four of its students have been honored with five gold medals for their exceptional academic performances.
Ms. Panuganti Susmitha Vanistands out with her remarkable achievement of winning two prestigious Gold Medals:
- Gold Medal for the Best Outgoing Student in B.Tech. Electronics & Communication Engineeringacross all JNTUH affiliated colleges.
- Pisupati Supriya Desai Gold Medalfor the Best Outgoing Student in B.Tech. Electronics & Communication Engineering in JNTUH affiliated colleges.
Mr. Kota Rohith Rajhas been awarded theGold Medal for the Best Outgoing Student in B.Tech. Mechanical Engineering (Mechatronics), distinguishing himself among all students from affiliated colleges.
In the field of Metallurgical & Materials Engineering,Mr. Gabbita Pranavhas earned theGold Medal for the Best Outgoing Studentin his discipline across all affiliated colleges.
Adding to the list of honorees,Mr. Samanthapudi Ananthhas been bestowed with theLate Prof. G.Purushotham Memorial Endowment Gold Medalfor securing the highest marks in Mathematics-I in the University and its affiliated colleges.
These medals will be formally presented to the students at the XII Convocation ceremony organized by JNTUH, Hyderabad.
The Management, Principal, Staff, and Students of MGIT extend their heartiest congratulations to these exceptional students for their outstanding achievements and for bringing pride to the institute.
